notes.title: Fixed game breaking bug of level 3 and onwards
notes.content:
You can now finish levels 3 and onward. 

Being solodev is hard work, but thanks to my friends who told about this bug, it should now be fixed.
My apologies of inconvenience this might have caused. 

- Developer of Liekki
